title: Restriction to a smaller open domain: mass bound and integer multiplicity (G4)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ U ⊆ ℝ^P with W open, and Y ∈ D_k(U). Let Y|_W := Y.restrictDomain hWU ∈ D_k(W), so Y|_W(ω) = Y(ω) for ω ∈ D^k(W) ⊆ D^k(U). Then M_W(Y|_W) ≤ M_U(Y) (that is, (Y|_W).mass ≤ Y.mass), and if Y is integer multiplicity in U then Y|_W is integer multiplicity in W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (hWU : W ⊆ U), IsOpen W → ∀ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (Y.restrictDomain hWU).mass ≤ Y.mass ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → IsIntegerMultiplicity (Y.restrictDomain hWU))
